LAREDO, Texas — Johnny Joe Gonzalez was arrested Wednesday morning, October 21, 2026, at 9:08 a.m. and booked into the Webb County Jail the same day on an alleged third-degree felony charge of continuous violence against the family, according to Webb County booking records.

In addition to the felony charge, Gonzalez was booked on five misdemeanor charges: interference with an emergency request for assistance (Class A misdemeanor); violation of a bond or protective order (Class A misdemeanor); reckless driving (misdemeanor); driving while intoxicated (Class B misdemeanor); and duty upon striking a fixture or highway landscape valued at $200 or more (Class B misdemeanor).

Bond had not been set on any of the charges as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956. The booking record listed the city as Laredo, TX 78046; the arresting agency was not listed.

A third-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to 10 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Johnny Joe Gonzalez is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.

title: BREAKING: Johnny Joe Gonzalez arrested on alleged third-degree felony continuous family violence charge
